## Changes
- **Update notifications.** Once a day, the app checks this repository's latest release on GitHub. When there is a newer version, you get one notification and a tray menu item that opens the release page. Nothing is downloaded or installed automatically; updating stays in your hands.
- **Asset mods are skipped.** Only code mods are checked: mods tagged "Code Mod" on their Paradox Mods page, or with a `.dll` file in their main folder. Asset mods (buildings, maps, props) are no longer read at all. They can be several gigabytes, and reading them at every start and every 30 minutes was slow. On a test PC with a 3.8 GB asset pack, a full check went from about 11 seconds to under 1 second.
- **Known limitation:** code hidden in a mod that is not tagged as a code mod and has no `.dll` in its main folder is not found. The README and the in-app text say so.
- **SmartScreen:** the README and the testing guide now describe the "Windows protected your PC" warning that appears on the first start, and how to continue.

## Download and verify
Download `CS2ModVerifier-v0.1.3-win-x64.zip`, extract it, and run `CS2ModVerifier.exe`. Nothing needs to be installed.

**Windows SmartScreen will most likely warn you**, because the exe is not code-signed. Check the download first, then choose "More info" and "Run anyway".

This release was built by GitHub Actions from the tagged commit. To check that your download is that build:

```
gh attestation verify CS2ModVerifier.exe --repo KDanielK/CS2ModVerifier
```

Or compare the SHA-256 hash (`Get-FileHash CS2ModVerifier.exe`, or `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`) with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Please note
CS2 Mod Verifier is an aid, not a guarantee of safety. No findings does not mean a mod is safe, and a finding does not mean a mod is harmful. See the README for what each check does and does not show.
